<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2TDvuJ2KygqHcBPtkDgePBK)_

Step 2 of 5. **Base: `414-devonthink-core` (#414)**; GitHub retargets to `main` when #414 merges and its branch is deleted. Stack: #414 → #415 → #418 → #419 → #420.

## What
- `sp-devonthink-tags` (`docs/tangles/academic/sp-devonthink-tags.org`): tags are read and written only in DEVONthink via `osascript`; one prompt completes from the database's tags and accepts new ones, with a confirmation that marks `(new)` tags; `sp-devonthink-tag-note` (`C-c k d t`, `C-u` removes); `sp-devonthink-split-comma-tags` splits the comma-joined tag after showing a plan (the old tag is kept).
- `sp-devonthink-browse` (`docs/tangles/academic/sp-devonthink-browse.org`): `C-c k d b` completes over the records grouped by DEVONthink group (cached; `sp-devonthink-browse-refresh`); Embark `o` open, `p` PDF, `n` litnote, `l` link, `t` tags (several marked records at once); `sp-devonthink-browse-query` (default `kind:pdf`).
- Both required from `sp-academic`; README rows added.

## Not tested
- AppleScript not run: listing tags (`name of (children of (tags group of database …))`), `lookup records with tags {…} in root of database …`, `set tags of …`, `location of every item`, `path of`. If tag listing fails the prompt still works without completion.
- Tested here: 16 ERT tests (merge/split/new-tag logic, parsing, de-duplication, grouping, multi-record tagging, plan text) and the tangle check.

## Manual testing
Mac, fish, `~/.config/emacs-modular`, DEVONthink open on `literature`. Use throw-away tags `test-tag-1`, `test-tag-2`.
- [ ] Check out: `cd ~/dotfiles; git fetch origin 415-devonthink-browse-tags; git checkout 415-devonthink-browse-tags`, restart Emacs.
- [ ] Unit tests: `cd ~/.config/emacs-modular; for f in tags browse; do emacs -Q --batch -L libraries/modules/academic -l ert -l tests/sp-devonthink-$f-test.el -f ert-run-tests-batch-and-exit; done` → 10 and 6 tests pass.
- [ ] `C-c k d b` → list of `KEY.pdf` grouped by DEVONthink group (first call takes seconds); `RET` on one opens it in DEVONthink.
- [ ] Embark (`C-.`) on a candidate: `p` opens the PDF in Emacs; `n` goes to its litnote (or the create prompt); `l` inserts `[[devonthink:UUID][key]]` in an Org buffer.
- [ ] `t` on one record, tag `test-tag-1` → confirmation "Tags: test-tag-1 (new). Create the new ones?" → `y`; the record shows the tag in DEVONthink's inspector.
- [ ] Several records: select 2–3 candidates (`embark-select`), `embark-act-all`, `t`, tag `test-tag-2` → "Added tags to N of N records".
- [ ] In a litnote with `#+devonthink:` (or a citekey): `C-c k d t` with an existing tag (completes) → "Added: 1 record changed"; `C-u C-c k d t` with the same tag → "Removed: 1 record changed".
- [ ] Typo guard: type a near-typo of an existing tag → shown as `(new)`; answer `n` → "Cancelled", nothing changed in DEVONthink.
- [ ] Split (do last): `M-x sp-devonthink-split-comma-tags`, pick the comma tag; `*devonthink tag split*` shows tag, parts, record count. Answer `n` → nothing changes. Run again, answer `y` → records now carry `negativity`, `value form`, `New German Reading of Marx` and still the old tag; delete the old tag in DEVONthink if happy.
- [ ] Clean up: remove `test-tag-1` and `test-tag-2` in DEVONthink.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

comment_regular_data.body:
**Merge order:** merge #437 first. This branch now contains #437's commits plus one new commit: `sp-devonthink-tag-note` follows `crossref` (asks before tagging the parent's record, since that tags the whole book).

**Extra manual test:**
- [ ] On the litnote of a chapter with no record of its own (crossref parent has one), `C-c k d t`, add a tag: it asks `Tag the record of PARENT (the whole book)?`; `n` changes nothing, `y` tags the parent's record.

**Revert:** revert the commit "Follow crossref in sp-devonthink-tag-note".
